variant.error: error TS2322: Type '"destructive"' is not assignable to type '"solid" | "soft" | "outline" | "plain" | (string & { 'From shadcn? Use tone="destructive" or tone="secondary". default is "solid"; ghost and link are "plain"': never; }) | undefined'.

source.doc: Visual weight: `solid` for the primary action, `soft` for secondary actions, `outline` for a quiet bordered control, `plain` for a borderless one. shadcn's `default` is `solid` (the default), `ghost` and `link` are `plain`, and `destructive` and `secondary` are tones: `tone="destructive"`. Any other string is a type error whose message names the fix. Variant is visual only. For a toggle, pass `aria-pressed`; for the current nav item, `aria-current="page"`.
source.code:
variant?:
    | "solid"
    | "soft"
    | "outline"
    | "plain"
    | (string & { 'From shadcn? Use tone="destructive" or tone="secondary". default is "solid"; ghost and link are "plain"': never })
    | undefined;

isLoading.error: error TS2322: Type 'boolean' is not assignable to type '{ 'Use <Button loading>': never; }'.

source.doc: Not a prop. Ouro UI uses `loading`: `<Button loading>`.
